architecture:
MaskableActorCriticPolicy(
  (features_extractor): LSTMSharedNet(
    (_token_emb): Embedding(50, 128, padding_idx=0)
    (_pos_enc): PositionalEncoding()
    (_lstm): LSTM(128, 128, num_layers=2, batch_first=True, dropout=0.1)
  )
  (pi_features_extractor): LSTMSharedNet(
    (_token_emb): Embedding(50, 128, padding_idx=0)
    (_pos_enc): PositionalEncoding()
    (_lstm): LSTM(128, 128, num_layers=2, batch_first=True, dropout=0.1)
  )
  (vf_features_extractor): LSTMSharedNet(
    (_token_emb): Embedding(50, 128, padding_idx=0)
    (_pos_enc): PositionalEncoding()
    (_lstm): LSTM(128, 128, num_layers=2, batch_first=True, dropout=0.1)
  )
  (mlp_extractor): MlpExtractor(
    (policy_net): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
      (1): Tanh()
      (2): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
      (3): Tanh()
    )
    (value_net): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
      (1): Tanh()
      (2): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
      (3): Tanh()
    )
  )
  (action_net): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=48, bias=True)
  (value_net): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=1, bias=True)
)
